text: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16): option A (sequencers treated exactly like relays: billing-DID IO agreement, registered chains, learns CO not Space; CO SHOULD use one sequencer across its Spaces; public Space naming its sequencer is a chosen disclosure) PLUS: a CO SHOULD designate a relay it already has an agreement with as its sequencer, so sequencing adds no new observer. D2 wording 'per-community' becomes 'designated by the CO'.
